cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Challenge by Proxy
cards.instruction: Persuade someone else to challenge a rule or authority before you risk doing it yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask the director to justify the overtime change. Say 'justify,' please; 'explain' lets him read the rule back to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because my disciplinary record would become the subject. Read the question exactly as I've written it; keep this about overtime.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just behind you. Face him when you ask, please. Don't turn round and make this look like my question.
